required_before_network: AgenKit license activation or explicit equivalent-workflow authorization
approval of normalized snapshot fields transmitted to api.typesafe.ai

calibration.probability_source: explicit target question, never direction confidence
calibration.entry: first valid ask after eligible decision
calibration.exit: first valid bid at/after entry+3600s within 5s
calibration.baseline: constant probability estimated only in development
calibration.overlap: primary labels only at hour boundary; purge crossing targets at development/evaluation split
calibration.eligibility: inconclusive until preregistered coverage and sample thresholds are met

acceptance.brier: report against development-only baseline, without treating improvement as profit approval
acceptance.execution: observe-only has no fills or PNL; hypothetical labels are not simulated executed orders
acceptance.statistics: report uncertainty and cross-asset dependence; no automatic approval from a point estimate

risk_action: candidate block only in shadow; does not change active paper session

retention.on_full: stop new evaluations and preserve journal

approval.plan: Offline build and equivalent workflow without AgenKit approved by user 2026-10-20

note: Draft. Do not treat this as a frozen experiment or an operational command.
